title: Question Bank
description: Knowledge-check questions derived from the source documents, each tied to a learning objective. Stage 3 output, consumed by build_training_deck.py for check-slide placement and by qa_training.py for question sanity checks. See reference/knowledge-checks.md for quality rules.

module_id.description: Which module's check slide this belongs on

stem.description: Tests the task, not trivia — see reference/knowledge-checks.md

key.description: option_id(s). One entry for mcq/true-false; may be more than one only when type is 'multi'.

rationale.description: Why the key is correct, citing the source anchor — becomes the facilitator answer-key entry

sources.description: source_map.json section_id(s) where the answer is stated. A question the documents don't answer is a [GAP] block on the plan, not a question here.
